summary: Bug: Not Able to Uncomplete the line from Workorder.
reported_issue: After marking a work-order line as Complete, the user could not uncomplete it (revert its status).
expected_after_fix: A completed line can be uncompleted (its status reverted) without error.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin, opened work order S9-24917 (/workorders/7a6b0b7f.../lines).
Located line 2 (WOL-NEW-24917-1) whose status badge read 'Complete'.
Selected the line's checkbox and opened the line bulk-action menu.
Chose 'Set line status' -> submenu offered 'Authorization required / Declined / Authorized / Complete'.
Selected 'Authorized' to revert (uncomplete) the completed line.
actual_now: The line status changed from 'Complete' to 'Approved' immediately, with no error message. The uncomplete/revert action succeeded.
notes: There is no literal 'Uncomplete' button; reverting a completed line is done via bulk action -> Set line status -> a pre-complete status (Authorized). This worked cleanly. Line left in 'Approved' state on disposable staging.
